import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset

# Set the style of seaborn

# Create a figure and axis

# Plot the survival rate per class

plt.ylabel('Survival Rate')

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
titanic_data = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure and axis
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))

# Plot the survival rate per class
sns.barplot(x='class', y='survived', data=titanic_data, ci=None, palette='muted')

# Add labels and title
plt.title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class on the Titanic')
plt.xlabel('Passenger Class')
plt.ylabel('Survival Rate')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
